summary.motive: Create an unstoppable misdirection interior shovel pass that exploits defensive ends widening to defend the quarterback perimeter option and sweep threat.
summary.whyItWorks: Guard pulling right and QB sprinting toward the sideline forces the edge defenders and linebackers to scrape wide; H slips underneath against the grain directly into the vacated interior tunnel for an easy forward completion and huge lane.
summary.failureMode: Defensive tackle penetrating into the backfield to disrupt the shovel toss path, or a disciplined interior linebacker refusing to bite on the perimeter action.

beats.title: Gun Trips Right Alignment & Shovel Motion Cue
beats.text: Andy Reid lines up in his signature 11P Trips look in the high red zone. H (Travis Kelce) aligns tight in the slot, prepared to slice back inside.

beats.title: Frontside Guard Power Pull & Perimeter Option Threat
beats.text: LG pulls fast on a Power track to the right. The QB sprints toward the sideline with the RB on an option pitch track, pulling SDE and Nickel DB wide.

beats.title: Shovel Flip into the Interior Tunnel
beats.text: As the defensive end widens to contain the QB, a massive tunnel opens in the A/B-gap. Kelce slips underneath and the QB flips a soft forward shovel pass into his hands in full stride.

beats.title: H Accelerates Behind Pulling Lead Block
beats.text: Kelce secures the forward pass and accelerates vertically directly behind the pulling LG, who delivers a crushing kickout block on the Mike linebacker.

beats.title: Chunk Gain into the Red Zone Secondary
beats.text: With the frontside sealed and second-level linebackers washed wide by the option flow, Kelce powers untouched into the secondary for a first down and goal.

relations.tell: Offensive guard pulls frontside while QB executes forward shovel option to TE inserting through A-gap.
